name: Balance and weight transfer
description: Develop stable posture and controlled weight shifts while standing, stepping and changing direction.

levels.name: Find a stable base
levels.completion_criterion: Hold a comfortable single-leg or split-stance position for 10 seconds on each side, repeating twice beside a stable support.
levels.can_do: Establish a stable stance and notice how shifting weight changes balance.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a clear, level surface and a nearby support; choose a stance appropriate to ability.

levels.name: Control weight shifts
levels.completion_criterion: Complete five slow weight shifts in different directions, returning to a stable stance after each without grabbing support.
levels.can_do: Shift weight deliberately while maintaining control of posture.
levels.safety_requirements: Stop if dizzy or in pain; do not practise on raised or unstable surfaces.

levels.name: Combine balance and movement
levels.completion_criterion: Perform a short sequence of stepping, pausing and turning in both directions with controlled stops and no loss of balance.
levels.can_do: Carry balance into continuous movement and direction changes.
levels.safety_requirements: Keep the area clear and adapt range of motion to current ability.

emoji_rationale: Balance and weight transfer are the central practice, rather than a specific sport or piece of equipment.
safety_notes: Practise on stable ground; no height, unstable props or risky balance tricks.

name: Catching with control
description: Track and receive a moving object by preparing the hands or an appropriate body position and adjusting to its path.

levels.name: Receive a predictable throw
levels.completion_criterion: Catch a large soft ball from a partner at a short distance on at least 5 of 10 gentle throws.
levels.can_do: Watch the object, prepare the hands and absorb the catch rather than swatting it away.

levels.name: Adjust to different paths
levels.completion_criterion: Catch a soft ball arriving at three comfortable heights or directions on at least 7 of 10 attempts.
levels.can_do: Adjust hand position and body placement to the path of the ball.

levels.name: Catch while moving
levels.completion_criterion: Move between two marked positions and catch 8 of 10 gentle throws without entering another person’s space.
levels.can_do: Coordinate movement, tracking and receiving under changing but predictable conditions.

emoji_rationale: Gloves are a clear visual cue for receiving and securing an object.
safety_notes: Use light, soft objects, adequate space and a partner who can throw gently.

name: Accurate throwing
description: Learn to direct a throw by coordinating stance, release, force and follow-through rather than relying on strength alone.

levels.name: Reach a broad target
levels.completion_criterion: Land a soft object inside a broad target from a comfortable short distance on 5 of 10 attempts.
levels.can_do: Coordinate stance, direction and release for a simple throw.

levels.name: Adjust force and distance
levels.completion_criterion: Hit two broad targets at different distances, scoring at least 6 of 10 attempts at each.
levels.can_do: Change force and release to suit the target rather than using the same throw every time.

levels.name: Place throws intentionally
levels.completion_criterion: Choose an appropriate throw for two different target locations and complete 8 of 10 attempts within the agreed target zones.
levels.can_do: Plan a throw and adjust technique based on distance and direction.

emoji_rationale: A target communicates deliberate aiming and accuracy.
safety_notes: Use soft objects and targets; make sure the throwing lane is clear.

name: Ball dribbling and control
description: Maintain control of a ball while keeping it moving with repeated hand, foot or implement contacts appropriate to the chosen activity.

levels.name: Keep the ball close
levels.completion_criterion: Maintain 10 consecutive controlled contacts with a ball in place or along a short straight path.
levels.can_do: Keep the ball within reachable space and use repeatable contacts.

levels.name: Move through markers
levels.completion_criterion: Guide the ball through a line of five wide-spaced markers without losing control more than once.
levels.can_do: Coordinate ball contact with forward movement and simple turns.

levels.name: Change direction and tempo
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a short slalom that includes two deliberate changes of direction and one tempo change while retaining control.
levels.can_do: Adjust touch, pace and body position to changing movement demands.

emoji_rationale: A ball is the defining object; this skill focuses on repeated controlled movement, not any one sport’s full technique.
safety_notes: Use an appropriate ball and open, level practice space.

name: Kicking with control
description: Direct a stationary or gently moving ball using controlled contact, aiming and adjustment of force.

levels.name: Kick towards a broad goal
levels.completion_criterion: Send a stationary soft ball into a broad target area from a short distance on 5 of 10 attempts.
levels.can_do: Make controlled contact and direct the ball rather than kicking as hard as possible.

levels.name: Vary direction and force
levels.completion_criterion: Pass to two target zones at different distances, reaching the intended zone on 6 of 10 attempts.
levels.can_do: Adjust contact and force for the required path.

levels.name: Pass while moving
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a sequence of five controlled passes with a partner while moving through an open marked area.
levels.can_do: Coordinate movement, visual scanning and ball direction.

emoji_rationale: A football is a direct symbol for a common form of controlled kicking.
safety_notes: Use a suitable ball and an open area away from traffic, glass and bystanders.

name: Striking an object with control
description: Practise contacting a moving or stationary object with a hand or appropriate implement and directing its path deliberately.

levels.name: Make consistent contact
levels.completion_criterion: Strike a stationary soft ball or suspended target gently on 5 of 10 attempts using a suitable technique.
levels.can_do: Set up a stable stance and coordinate the contact point.

levels.name: Direct the path
levels.completion_criterion: Send a slow feed into one of two wide target zones on 6 of 10 attempts.
levels.can_do: Adjust contact angle and timing to influence direction.

levels.name: Respond to a moving object
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a short sequence of controlled strikes from gentle, predictable feeds while staying balanced and within a clear area.
levels.can_do: Combine visual tracking, timing and directional control.

emoji_rationale: A ball in play represents the outcome of a controlled strike without tying the skill to a single racket sport.
safety_notes: Use an appropriate lightweight object or implement, eye protection where required, and ample space.

name: Hopping and rhythmic skipping
description: Practise single-leg hops and alternating skipping patterns with rhythm, spatial control and balanced transitions.

levels.name: Find the rhythm
levels.completion_criterion: Complete five small hops on a comfortable side, then repeat on the other side, with pauses as needed.
levels.can_do: Coordinate push-off and landing while keeping the movement small and controlled.

levels.name: Travel through a pattern
levels.completion_criterion: Move through four ground markers using a chosen hop or skip pattern without stepping outside the practice lane.
levels.can_do: Control direction, rhythm and spacing while travelling.

levels.name: Change pattern smoothly
levels.completion_criterion: Combine hopping and skipping across a short marked sequence, changing pattern at two clear cues without losing control.
levels.can_do: Transition between footwork patterns and adjust rhythm deliberately.

emoji_rationale: A flamingo evokes single-leg control and distinguishes this locomotor pattern from running or jumping.
safety_notes: Use a level non-slip surface and low-impact movements; avoid maximal jumps or repeated practice through pain.

name: Jumping and landing with control
description: Develop controlled take-off and landing for simple jumps in place and over low ground markers.

levels.name: Land stably
levels.completion_criterion: Perform five small two-foot jumps in place, holding a balanced landing after each.
levels.can_do: Coordinate take-off and landing without rushing into the next repetition.

levels.name: Clear a low marker
levels.completion_criterion: Jump over a low flat marker in two directions and hold a stable landing for two seconds on 4 of 5 attempts.
levels.can_do: Adjust jump direction and landing position.

levels.name: Combine directions
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a short sequence of low jumps with changes of direction and stable pauses, without clipping markers or losing balance.
levels.can_do: Use controlled take-off and landing within a planned movement sequence.

emoji_rationale: A kangaroo suggests jumping while remaining distinct from one-foot hopping and skipping.
safety_notes: Start with low-impact jumps on a clear, suitable surface. Do not attempt height, flips or tricks without qualified instruction.

name: Swimming fundamentals
description: Build water confidence, basic floating and propulsion, and the ability to practise a chosen basic stroke in an appropriate swimming environment.

levels.name: Become comfortable in water
levels.completion_criterion: During a supervised beginner session, practise controlled exhalation, supported floating or body-position exercises chosen by a qualified instructor.
levels.can_do: Follow basic instruction and develop comfort with breathing and body position in the water.
levels.safety_requirements: Practise only in an appropriate supervised pool or lesson setting; an inexperienced swimmer must not enter water alone.

levels.name: Propel and return safely
levels.completion_criterion: With instructor approval, travel a short pool distance using a taught basic stroke and return to the wall without panic.
levels.can_do: Coordinate breathing and propulsion for a short controlled swim.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a lifeguarded facility and stay within the instructor-approved depth and distance.

levels.name: Swim a short continuous distance
levels.completion_criterion: In a supervised pool, complete a continuous 25-metre swim using a chosen basic stroke, then exit safely using the pool’s normal exit.
levels.can_do: Sustain basic stroke coordination and plan a safe finish.
levels.safety_requirements: This criterion is not open-water certification. Never swim alone; use qualified instruction and adapt to individual ability.

emoji_rationale: The swimmer symbol directly identifies a progressive aquatic skill.
safety_notes: Water confidence and pool practice must progress under supervision. Never swim alone; the skill does not establish competence for rivers, lakes or open water.

name: Cycling confidently and safely
description: Develop starting, stopping, steering, signalling, route awareness and simple bicycle checks for everyday riding.

levels.name: Start, steer and stop
levels.completion_criterion: In a traffic-free area, start, ride a straight line, make a broad turn and stop predictably on five consecutive attempts.
levels.can_do: Control speed and braking before dealing with traffic.

levels.name: Ride with awareness
levels.completion_criterion: On a quiet separated route, scan behind when appropriate, signal clearly where safe and manage simple gear changes.
levels.can_do: Combine balance, observation and communication of intended movement.

levels.name: Plan a suitable route
levels.completion_criterion: Plan and ride a route appropriate to current ability, checking the bicycle, surface, weather and local rules before starting.
levels.can_do: Choose safer route options and ride predictably for the environment.

emoji_rationale: A bicycle is specific to the practice and differs from off-road mountain biking.
safety_notes: Use a correctly fitting bicycle, a suitable helmet where recommended/required, efficient brakes and lights when needed. Traffic rules differ by country; beginners should practise away from traffic and consider qualified cycle training.

name: Mountain biking fundamentals
description: Develop controlled bike handling on suitable off-road trails, including body position, braking, surface awareness and choosing a safe line.

levels.name: Prepare for a gentle trail
levels.completion_criterion: Check bike condition and protective equipment, then ride a broad, gentle, traffic-free track at a pace where stopping is easy.
levels.can_do: Recognise terrain changes and maintain a comfortable, controlled position.

levels.name: Handle simple trail features
levels.completion_criterion: Ride a beginner-rated trail with small surface changes and broad turns while braking before obstacles and remaining in control.
levels.can_do: Adjust speed, braking and line to the trail instead of reacting at the last second.

levels.name: Choose lines on varied terrain
levels.completion_criterion: Complete an appropriate marked route, explaining the chosen line around several non-technical obstacles and yielding safely to others.
levels.can_do: Read terrain ahead and make deliberate, conservative line choices.

emoji_rationale: The mountain symbol distinguishes off-road trail riding from everyday cycling.
safety_notes: Use a trail rated for the rider’s ability, helmet and protective equipment. Do not attempt jumps, drops or technical features as a progression requirement.

name: Hiking and trail preparation
description: Plan and complete walks on suitable outdoor routes by matching the route to ability, checking conditions and carrying appropriate essentials.

levels.name: Prepare a short local walk
levels.completion_criterion: Choose a familiar short route, check the forecast, footwear and water needs, and tell someone the planned route when appropriate.
levels.can_do: Prepare for a walk rather than setting out without checking conditions.

levels.name: Follow a marked trail
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a suitable marked trail, track progress and adjust pace or breaks to keep the outing comfortable.
levels.can_do: Match route length and terrain to current ability and conditions.

levels.name: Plan an unfamiliar route
levels.completion_criterion: Create a route plan with expected timing, navigation backup, essentials, a turnaround point and a plan for changing conditions.
levels.can_do: Anticipate common route and weather changes and explain when to shorten or cancel the outing.

emoji_rationale: Boots are a recognisable symbol for walking routes and outdoor preparation.
safety_notes: Choose trails within ability, check local alerts and weather, carry essentials and a communication plan. Avoid hazardous terrain beyond experience.

name: Running and pacing
description: Practise relaxed running or run-walk intervals with a controlled pace and a repeatable routine rather than chasing speed.

levels.name: Start with run-walk intervals
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a comfortable 10-minute session alternating short easy runs and walking, adjusting intervals before form breaks down.
levels.can_do: Choose an easy pace and use walking breaks deliberately.

levels.name: Maintain an easy pace
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a 15-minute easy run or run-walk session while maintaining a pace that allows short sentences and finishing in control.
levels.can_do: Regulate effort through breathing and perception rather than speed alone.

levels.name: Plan and review a session
levels.completion_criterion: Plan a comfortable 20–30-minute run-walk session, adjust pace to route and conditions, and note what pacing pattern felt sustainable.
levels.can_do: Make repeatable pacing decisions and reflect on the session without relying on a personal-best result.

emoji_rationale: The running icon describes the activity; the progression focuses on pacing, not racing.
safety_notes: Progress gradually, use suitable footwear and stop for sharp pain, dizziness or unusual symptoms. Time and distance targets should be adapted to the individual.

name: Trail running fundamentals
description: Run on suitable natural paths while scanning the terrain, adjusting stride and pace, and choosing safe footing on changing surfaces.

levels.name: Run-walk on an easy trail
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a short run-walk on a wide, dry, familiar natural path, looking ahead and slowing before uneven sections.
levels.can_do: Notice surface changes and adapt stride without forcing speed.

levels.name: Manage varied surfaces
levels.completion_criterion: Complete an easy loop with a few gentle changes of surface while staying in control and choosing stable footing.
levels.can_do: Adjust pace and step placement to terrain rather than maintaining road-running rhythm.

levels.name: Plan a suitable trail session
levels.completion_criterion: Select an ability-appropriate marked trail, check conditions, plan an exit/turnaround option and complete it using deliberate pacing and terrain scanning.
levels.can_do: Combine route preparation, surface reading and effort management.

emoji_rationale: A tree evokes natural trails and distinguishes terrain-focused running from general running.
safety_notes: Stay on suitable marked trails, avoid unstable or exposed terrain, check weather and carry appropriate supplies. Do not equate this skill with mountain running or technical scrambling.

name: Cross-country skiing basics
description: Learn the foundational balance, glide, propulsion and speed-control skills needed to move on cross-country skis on beginner terrain.

levels.name: Get comfortable on skis
levels.completion_criterion: With a beginner instructor or experienced guide, put on fitted equipment, stand and take short steps on flat beginner terrain.
levels.can_do: Become familiar with the equipment and basic balance.

levels.name: Link glide and propulsion
levels.completion_criterion: On a groomed beginner trail, link short controlled glides with a taught classic stride or beginner technique, then stop as instructed.
levels.can_do: Coordinate weight transfer, propulsion and speed control.

levels.name: Complete an easy loop
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a short groomed beginner loop with controlled movement, stopping and turns appropriate to the lesson, following trail etiquette.
levels.can_do: Combine the basic technique into a continuous easy outing.

emoji_rationale: Skis are specific to the snow-based movement skill.
safety_notes: Begin with competent instruction, suitable fitted equipment and groomed beginner terrain. Conditions and trail etiquette matter; do not progress to steep or backcountry terrain as part of this skill.

name: Roller-skating fundamentals
description: Learn a stable stance, controlled rolling, turning and stopping on roller skates or inline skates before attempting speed or tricks.

levels.name: Stand, roll and stop
levels.completion_criterion: On flat, traffic-free ground, practise a stable stance, short glides and a taught beginner stop while wearing protective gear.
levels.can_do: Maintain balance and understand how to stop before building speed.

levels.name: Turn and control direction
levels.completion_criterion: Follow a wide figure-eight or similar marked path and stop at two planned points without colliding or entering another person’s path.
levels.can_do: Combine controlled turns and stopping in a predictable practice area.

levels.name: Navigate a beginner course
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a simple marked course with turns, slowdowns and stops while scanning the surface and yielding to others.
levels.can_do: Maintain control while responding to predictable obstacles and shared-space rules.

emoji_rationale: Inline/roller skates give this skill a specific visual identifier.
safety_notes: Wear helmet, wrist guards, knee and elbow protection. Practise on flat, dry, traffic-free ground; avoid hills, crowded paths and tricks until appropriately trained.

name: Paddling basics
description: Practise basic paddle strokes, steering and stopping in a suitable small craft while learning to prepare for a safe supervised outing.

levels.name: Learn the equipment and stroke
levels.completion_criterion: Identify the craft’s basic safety equipment, fit a suitable life jacket and practise the basic paddle movement on land or under instruction.
levels.can_do: Understand the paddle orientation, basic stroke and safety setup.

levels.name: Move and turn on calm water
levels.completion_criterion: With appropriate supervision on calm sheltered water, paddle a short route, turn both ways and stop on instruction.
levels.can_do: Combine forward propulsion, steering and stopping.

levels.name: Plan a short supervised outing
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a short route with weather and water-condition checks, suitable equipment, a partner/group and a communication plan, then complete it under appropriate supervision.
levels.can_do: Link paddling technique with conservative route and safety decisions.

emoji_rationale: A canoe/kayak symbol clearly signals paddle-propelled water activity.
safety_notes: Wear a properly fitted life jacket; match craft, conditions and route to experience; follow local rules. Beginners should not go alone or into moving/open water without appropriate instruction and equipment.

name: Pilates foundations
description: Build a beginner practice around controlled movement, breathing, attention and alignment in an appropriate Pilates class or guided routine.

levels.name: Learn the basic principles
levels.completion_criterion: Complete an introductory guided session and identify how breathing, attention and controlled movement are used in the chosen exercises.
levels.can_do: Follow beginner instructions and notice how movement quality matters more than speed.

levels.name: Link a short sequence
levels.completion_criterion: Perform a short beginner mat sequence with controlled transitions and the breathing cues taught by the instructor.
levels.can_do: Keep attention on alignment, control and smooth transitions through several exercises.

levels.name: Practise and reflect independently
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a familiar beginner sequence with consistent control, describe two technique cues that help, and identify when an exercise should be modified.
levels.can_do: Build a repeatable practice while recognising personal limits and the value of qualified feedback.

emoji_rationale: The seated meditator evokes attentive mind-body practice without claiming Pilates is meditation.
safety_notes: Choose instruction and modifications appropriate to individual needs; do not use the app as medical or rehabilitation advice. Stop if an exercise causes pain or concerning symptoms.

name: Gymnastics movement foundations
description: Develop foundational body shapes, controlled transitions, balance and safe landings as preparation for recreational gymnastics.

levels.name: Practise basic shapes
levels.completion_criterion: Under qualified supervision, demonstrate a small set of basic static shapes and controlled two-foot landings on an appropriate mat.
levels.can_do: Recognise body position and finish simple movements in a stable stance.

levels.name: Link safe floor movements
levels.completion_criterion: Under supervision, link a short beginner sequence of taught shapes, steps and balances with controlled pauses.
levels.can_do: Move between foundational shapes without rushing or losing awareness of the landing area.

levels.name: Perform a controlled sequence
levels.completion_criterion: Demonstrate a short individual beginner sequence selected by a qualified coach, including controlled transitions and stable finishes.
levels.can_do: Combine body control, balance and sequence memory at an individually appropriate level.

emoji_rationale: A gymnast represents whole-body movement and floor-based body control.
safety_notes: Use suitable mats and qualified instruction. No flips, unsupported inversions, high apparatus or acrobatic skills should be attempted as self-guided challenges.

name: Sportsmanship and fair play
description: Apply shared rules honestly, communicate respectfully and handle disagreements constructively in recreational sport or games.

levels.name: Know and follow the rules
levels.completion_criterion: Before a recreational game, explain three key rules and apply them honestly during play.
levels.can_do: Understand the shared rules and acknowledge own mistakes.

levels.name: Handle a disagreement respectfully
levels.completion_criterion: During a game, resolve one rules disagreement by pausing, explaining the concern calmly and using an agreed rule or neutral decision method.
levels.can_do: Communicate clearly without escalating conflict.

levels.name: Support a fair game
levels.completion_criterion: Help a group agree on fair rules and inclusive participation, then reflect on whether the game followed those agreements.
levels.can_do: Contribute to a fair and welcoming environment rather than focusing only on winning.

emoji_rationale: A handshake represents fair participation and respectful cooperation.

name: Dance rhythm and basic steps
description: Develop timing, weight changes and short repeatable movement sequences that can serve as a foundation for learning a specific dance style.

levels.name: Find the beat
levels.completion_criterion: Clap or step to a steady musical pulse for 30 seconds and restart on the beat after one deliberate pause.
levels.can_do: Hear a regular pulse and coordinate a simple movement with it.

levels.name: Repeat a short sequence
levels.completion_criterion: Learn and repeat a simple 4–8-count step sequence to music three times with broadly consistent timing.
levels.can_do: Remember a short movement pattern and keep timing with the music.

levels.name: Adapt timing to music
levels.completion_criterion: Perform a familiar short sequence to two pieces with different tempos or accents, adjusting movement without losing the core rhythm.
levels.can_do: Use rhythm and timing as transferable foundations for other dance styles.

emoji_rationale: Footprints indicate steps and timing without privileging one dance genre.
safety_notes: Choose a clear practice area and adapt footwork to mobility and comfort. This skill is not a substitute for style-specific instruction.

name: Salsa dancing
description: Learn the timing, basic steps, direction changes and partner communication that make salsa a recognisable social dance practice.

levels.name: Learn a basic step
levels.completion_criterion: Perform a basic salsa step pattern to music for three short repetitions while keeping a steady count.
levels.can_do: Coordinate weight changes and basic timing.

levels.name: Add turns and partner awareness
levels.completion_criterion: Practise a simple turn or direction change, solo or with a consenting partner, while maintaining timing and comfortable spacing.
levels.can_do: Coordinate steps and turns without pulling or forcing a partner.

levels.name: Dance a short social sequence
levels.completion_criterion: Combine a basic step, a turn and a direction change into a short sequence to music, adjusting to the partner and floor space.
levels.can_do: Use timing, lead/follow communication and floor awareness in a simple social dance.

emoji_rationale: The dancer emoji represents social dance; salsa-specific identity comes from the name and progression, not the icon alone.
safety_notes: Practise with enough space; partner movements should be consensual and comfortable. Avoid lifts or acrobatics.

name: Hip-hop dance foundations
description: Learn groove, basic bounce, isolations and short rhythmic combinations within hip-hop dance practice.

levels.name: Find a basic groove
levels.completion_criterion: Perform a simple bounce/groove pattern for 30 seconds to music and stop/start on a clear cue.
levels.can_do: Coordinate body movement with a steady beat.

levels.name: Combine basic movements
levels.completion_criterion: Link three taught foundation movements into a short combination and repeat it twice in time with music.
levels.can_do: Recall and connect a few movements without rushing.

levels.name: Perform and adapt a combination
levels.completion_criterion: Perform a short combination and adapt its timing or energy to a different section of the music while keeping the movement controlled.
levels.can_do: Use groove, isolation and musical interpretation in a simple routine.

emoji_rationale: Headphones suggest music-led practice while remaining visually distinct from ballroom and Latin partner dances.
safety_notes: Use a clear floor and comfortable range. Advanced power moves, drops and inversions require qualified teaching and are not part of this progression.

name: Contemporary dance foundations
description: Explore grounded movement, balance, controlled changes of level and expressive short sequences characteristic of contemporary dance.

levels.name: Explore controlled shapes
levels.completion_criterion: Create and repeat a short sequence of three standing shapes with deliberate weight shifts and pauses.
levels.can_do: Use balance, levels and whole-body movement to express an idea.

levels.name: Move through levels
levels.completion_criterion: Link a standing movement, a lower-level movement and a controlled return to standing on a suitable surface.
levels.can_do: Transition between movement levels with awareness of balance and space.

levels.name: Create a short phrase
levels.completion_criterion: Create and perform a 20–30-second phrase using a repeated motif and two changes of direction or level.
levels.can_do: Combine technique and intentional movement choices into a coherent phrase.

emoji_rationale: The dancer icon represents embodied technique; this progression is specifically contemporary rather than a generic ballet skill.
safety_notes: Use a suitable clear floor and adapt floorwork to current ability. Do not force stretches or unsupported drops.

name: Jazz dance foundations
description: Practise jazz-walks, isolations, kicks or turns at a beginner level, combining clean shapes with musical timing.

levels.name: Learn foundation movements
levels.completion_criterion: Practise two beginner jazz movements separately with control and appropriate range of motion.
levels.can_do: Recognise and execute basic jazz movement vocabulary.

levels.name: Connect a short combination
levels.completion_criterion: Combine three taught movements into an 8-count phrase and repeat it with consistent timing.
levels.can_do: Link movement vocabulary into a short, repeatable sequence.

levels.name: Perform with musical phrasing
levels.completion_criterion: Perform a short phrase and deliberately accent two musical cues while maintaining alignment and controlled finishes.
levels.can_do: Coordinate technique and interpretation with musical phrasing.

emoji_rationale: The saxophone references jazz dance’s musical lineage and distinguishes this style from other dance practices.
safety_notes: Warm up appropriately and use controlled ranges. Turns, kicks and jumps should remain within comfortable ability.

name: Breaking foundations
description: Explore beginner top-rock footwork, rhythm, levels and safe transitions as an entry point to breaking culture and movement.

levels.name: Learn basic top-rock
levels.completion_criterion: Learn and repeat a short beginner top-rock pattern while staying upright and keeping time with music.
levels.can_do: Use footwork and rhythm as a safe entry point to breaking.

levels.name: Link footwork patterns
levels.completion_criterion: Connect two taught standing footwork patterns with a clear transition and repeat the combination twice.
levels.can_do: Recall and transition between beginner movement patterns.

levels.name: Create a short round
levels.completion_criterion: Create a short beginner round combining learned standing footwork and a personal variation, maintaining control and awareness of space.
levels.can_do: Build a simple personal combination grounded in rhythm and movement choice.

emoji_rationale: A dance-floor disco ball evokes performance and dance culture without implying a specific trick.
safety_notes: This progression excludes headspins, power moves, drops and unsupported inversions. Learn higher-risk breaking skills only with qualified instruction, suitable surfaces and spotting.

name: Boogie-woogie dancing
description: Learn the rhythmic footwork, bounce and improvised partner interaction characteristic of boogie-woogie dance.

levels.name: Learn the basic rhythm
levels.completion_criterion: Practise the beginner rhythm and basic step pattern to suitable music for three short repetitions.
levels.can_do: Maintain the characteristic pulse and weight changes.

levels.name: Vary the footwork
levels.completion_criterion: Add two simple footwork variations while maintaining the shared rhythm and personal balance.
levels.can_do: Use improvisation instead of relying only on fixed choreography.

levels.name: Dance with partner awareness
levels.completion_criterion: Dance a short improvised sequence with a consenting partner, maintaining timing, comfortable connection and space awareness.
levels.can_do: Combine rhythm, responsive partner work and controlled variation.

emoji_rationale: The dancing figure signals partner/social dance and is acceptable as a shared icon; distinctiveness lives in the skill definition.
safety_notes: Partner contact and movement must be comfortable and consensual; no lifts or acrobatic figures are included.

name: Latin partner-dance foundations
description: Develop timing, weight transfer, posture and basic partner awareness across beginner Latin ballroom dance practice.

levels.name: Recognise timing and weight changes
levels.completion_criterion: Practise a beginner rhythm pattern and basic steps from one chosen Latin ballroom dance with a qualified or reliable beginner lesson.
levels.can_do: Coordinate weight transfer with music and basic timing.

levels.name: Link steps with control
levels.completion_criterion: Combine two basic step patterns and a direction change while maintaining posture and floor awareness.
levels.can_do: Connect beginner movement figures without forcing speed or range.

levels.name: Perform a short sequence
levels.completion_criterion: Perform a short sequence of learned figures to music, keeping timing and partner/floor awareness across transitions.
levels.can_do: Use the foundational technique consistently in a short routine.

emoji_rationale: A percussion instrument suggests rhythmic Latin dance practice rather than a single named dance.
safety_notes: This is a broad foundation, not a promise to master all five competition dances. Partner contact should be consensual and comfortable.

name: Ballroom standard dance foundations
description: Practise the posture, frame, basic steps and controlled movement used in standard ballroom dance such as waltz or tango.

levels.name: Learn posture and a basic pattern
levels.completion_criterion: Practise a beginner posture/frame and one simple step pattern from a chosen standard dance, solo or with a consenting partner.
levels.can_do: Understand basic posture, timing and direction.

levels.name: Travel with control
levels.completion_criterion: Link two beginner patterns while maintaining a comfortable frame, direction and spacing.
levels.can_do: Move around the practice floor without abrupt pulling or collisions.

levels.name: Complete a short dance phrase
levels.completion_criterion: Perform a short phrase to music with controlled direction changes, timing and awareness of other dancers.
levels.can_do: Apply the basic standard-dance technique in continuous movement.

emoji_rationale: The formal hat suggests standard ballroom presentation and is distinguishable from the more casual dance emoji used elsewhere.
safety_notes: Use a clear floor and comfortable partner connection. This does not include competition-level lifts or advanced figures.

name: Disco dance foundations
description: Practise energetic, rhythm-led disco dance movements using basic steps, controlled arm/body actions and beginner turns within personal ability.

levels.name: Learn a basic phrase
levels.completion_criterion: Learn a short beginner disco phrase with two simple steps and a clear arm pattern.
levels.can_do: Coordinate high-energy movements with the beat at a comfortable pace.

levels.name: Add direction changes
levels.completion_criterion: Repeat a short phrase with one controlled direction change and a simple turn appropriate to ability.
levels.can_do: Link steps and changes of direction while maintaining timing.

levels.name: Perform and adapt a phrase
levels.completion_criterion: Perform a short phrase with two musical accents and adapt its energy to the music without losing control.
levels.can_do: Combine rhythm, movement quality and a short repeatable choreography.

emoji_rationale: The disco ball is directly associated with disco dance and differs from the other selected icons.
safety_notes: Use a non-slip floor and comfortable range of motion. Jumps, rapid turns and kicks should be scaled to ability; avoid crowded spaces.
